openQuestions.title: Fix the race that attributes the worker LoAF entry to the next run
openQuestions.detail: worker.js reports the block result 30ms later from an observed[] array filled by the PerformanceObserver callback, which may not have been delivered yet. With the flag, blocking-a-worker's first run reported "Nothing observed it" and the second run reported the entry; hand-rolled-loaf showed the reverse pattern. Call observer.takeRecords() before posting the "blocked" message (or wait for the callback), and clear observed[] only for entries belonging to that run.

openQuestions.title: Add the LongAnimationFrameWorker flag instructions
openQuestions.detail: LongAnimationFrameWorker is status "test" in runtime_enabled_features.json5, so it is not even covered by the experimental-web-platform-features flag. With --enable-blink-features=LongAnimationFrameWorker the worker lists long-animation-frame and the suite goes 6/6. None of the pages say this (rule 10).
